metaDescription: What is expected to leave and arrive in your accounts over the coming weeks, day by day, and where the balances will stand.
title: Cash-flow calendar
subtext: EMIs, rent, subscriptions, bills and salary on the days they are expected, with the balance each account should have after them.
empty: Nothing to lay out yet. Horizon needs a few months of statements with regular payments, and a known balance.
belowZero: {name} is expected to go below zero on {date}. Move money there before then.
lockedText: Subscribers see the next {days} days, the lowest point, and each account's expected balance after every day.
without: Not laid out (no known balance or too little history): {names}.
how: Each account starts from its balance where the statements end. Every day takes off everyday spending at its recent average, and adds regular payments and income on their expected dates. Irregular income is not counted, so the estimate errs on the careful side.
